items.headline: Schedule your most used Copilot prompts
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot scheduled prompts let users automate routine interactions at specified times and frequencies. Users can create up to 10 scheduled prompts for recurring work like summarizing information, building planning checklists, or drafting emails that follow a weekly pattern. Agent Builder now supports hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly cadences, reducing manual prompting and automating routine tasks.

items.headline: Nebraska Supreme Court blasts AI-authored court filings, recommends discipline
items.summary: Nebraska Supreme Court suspended Omaha attorney Greg Lake indefinitely in April 2026 after 57 of 63 citations in a divorce appellate brief were flagged as defective, including 20 outright hallucinations and 3 entirely fabricated cases generated by AI. Lake initially denied using AI when pressed by justices, then admitted it two days before suspension, calling it a grave error of judgment. This is the first US bar discipline action to suspend practice entirely over AI-related filing errors.

items.headline: EU AI Act Transparency Obligations Preparing for Compliance by 2 August 2026
items.summary: Article 50 of the EU AI Act becomes enforceable on August 2, 2026, requiring transparency obligations for chatbot disclosure, AI content marking, and deepfake labeling. These rules apply to any AI system in four specified situations, not just high-risk systems, affecting every business using generative AI to produce content. For AI systems placed on the market before August 2, machine-readable content marking is deferred to December 2, 2026. Draft Commission guidelines are expected ahead of the deadline.
